decisions.reason: As a low-risk design extension of the core drainage range that gained stronger website positioning in 2024, it is cheap to keep open and still fits the firm's design-led offer.

This product is closely aligned with the firm's strategic focus on modern seamless and barrier-free bathroom solutions, and its continued dedicated presentation suggests sufficiently positive prospects to retain it.

Although pump-based drainage is a more uncertain and support-intensive option and the firm has already pruned a related offering, this 2024 launch is still young enough to justify keeping the option open for another year.
